neighbours.label: the item being replaced or changed from, in a substitution or change (the 'from' side: '20 hours' raised to 90, the belt drive replaced)
fire: The city raised the speed limit from 30 miles per hour to 40.
Engineers swapped the steel frame for a lighter carbon one.
The bakery replaced its old wood oven with an electric one.
Congress extended the deadline from June to September.
The team switched the copper wiring out for fiber cables.
The old manual approach to billing was replaced by software.
She traded her bicycle for a used scooter.
The school cut recess from 45 minutes to 20.
quiet: The city posted the speed limit on new signs along the road.
Engineers painted the steel frame a bright shade of red.
The bakery cleaned its old wood oven every Sunday.
Congress met the deadline in June without trouble.
The team installed the copper wiring in the new house.
The old manual for the printer was lost in the move.
She rode her bicycle to the market every morning.
The school held recess for 45 minutes after lunch.

notes: Logit effect of the - pole (into/to) promotes replace/become; the + pole looks like the source side. Probes: '20 hours to 90 hours' 0.33 (on ' hours'), 'belt drive' 0.26, 'linear approach' 0.20, 'wooden beams for steel' 0.16; 'Convert the file' and 'water into wine' ~0.01. Weak.
